notes: The guide confirms the reusable Guardian toolkit but does not name a dungeon-specific trick; Mass Envenom is canonical Poison evidence for Remove Corruption.
Typhoon and Incapacitating Roar are stops, not spell-school lockouts.
Toxic Spew is canonical Poison evidence; the current Guardian guide supplies no more specific dungeon advice.
Ratings combine the sourced class toolkit with canonical WHELP mechanic typing.
Remove Corruption covers Toxic Spores; Soothe covers Bestial Wrath or Mother's Wrath.
The guide itself labels every dungeon section as having no special Guardian trick.
Cleanse Heartstop Poison or Curse of Doom and Soothe Fel Rage; Typhoon can interrupt eligible Seduction channelers.
Typhoon displacement can reduce group damage if it un-stacks enemies, so use it deliberately.
Remove Corruption covers the named Poisons and Soothe is situational on enraged enemies.
Vortex can preserve enemy stacking after Typhoon and help the tank control eligible packs.
Remove Corruption covers Poison and Curse applications; area control can stop A Knot of Snakes or contain eligible tormentors.
No guide-backed Enrage target is asserted.
Cleanse Poison Nova, Hex, Lingering Fluid, or Serpent Strike and control Animated Gold.
Do not remove Ancestral Fury; its downside increases party damage. Soothe Bestial Berserk instead.
Typhoon can disrupt eligible Flaming Barrage or Ice Shield casters; the guide names no cleanse or Soothe target.
No mechanic spell ID is asserted because the guide's Guardian section does not provide one.

recommendations: Incapacitating Roar and Typhoon can control clustered orbs; Skull Bash covers one orb.
Save offensive cooldown value when practical and swap immediately to the priority enemy.
Use normal Druid mobility and coordinate orb collection without dragging enemies through the group.
Remove Corruption can dispel two eligible applications during the duration; healing is the fallback.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Pumps's Patch 12.1.0 Guardian Druid utility guidance. The guide repeats generic utility and states that its dungeon sections have no special tricks; canonical mechanic records therefore support the ratings without being presented as guide quotations.
